snippet.title: Threads of War - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of Battle City, reimagined with rogue-lite progression and Ukrainian embroidery style. Each tank holds a backstory of a man who went to war to protect his loved ones. Choose your path and combat style, play solo or with a friend, and drive the enemy out of Ukraine.

Already available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2917630/Threads_of_War/
